name: NiNet Data Center
notes: Commercial colocation/cloud facility at Bulevar Nemanjica 25, Nis. Baxtel lists the site as operational and 1 MW; DataCenterMap describes redundancy, 99.95% availability, 42U racks, and three independent optical access networks.

name: IPKO Data Center
notes: IPKO states its data center is in the industrial area of Fushe Kosove with a backup location in Ulpiana, Pristina, and offers colocation services. Listed under the batch's Kosovo-Metohija division; sources present the location as Kosovo.

name: Telecom of Kosovo Core Telecom / IT Data Center
notes: Aggregator listings identify one Telecom of Kosovo data center in Pristina. Listed under the batch's Kosovo-Metohija division; sources present the location as Kosovo.

name: ZELEN DATA CENTAR
notes: First green data center in Serbia, located in Technology Park in Vrsac; HiTeam opening notice says the data center building covers 1,772 sq m and construction began in September 2015.

name: BeeNet RS-2 Vrsac
notes: BeeNet says it operates RS-2 Vrsac with 1,000 sq m facility size, total power up to 2 MW, up to 20 kW per rack, and links up to 100 Gbit/s.

name: NEOplanta / Neo Data Center
notes: E-CAPS describes NEOplanta as Novi Sad's first cloud data center, built to Tier 3 standards; company address is Novosadskog sajma 2, Novi Sad.
